# Script to run iqtree on the constrained trees. You will need the "run_iqtree_constrained.sh" file generated by the "outgroup_constrained.py" script. 

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
#!/bin/bash -l
#SBATCH -J iqtree2
#SBATCH --mail-type START,FAIL,END
#SBATCH --mail-user Julia.Levinstein@campus.lmu.de
#SBATCH -t 2-00:00:00
#SBATCH --clusters=biohpc_gen
#SBATCH --partition=biohpc_gen_normal
#SBATCH --mem=8G
#SBATCH -n 1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=4

eval "$(conda shell.bash hook)"
CONDA_ENV_PATH="/dss/dsslegfs01/pr53da/pr53da-dss-0036/projects/2025__neosex/conda_envs/bio_env"
conda activate "$CONDA_ENV_PATH"


bash run_iqtree_constrained.sh


```
